multiplechoiceresponse.p: What is the primary purpose of the Tier 1 service desk?

choice.div: Resolve first-contact requests and triage what cannot be closed.
Rebuild servers and manage the data centre.

div.p: Tier 1 handles first contact: password resets, access requests, simple how-to questions, and triage. Deeper work is escalated to Tier 2 or Tier 3.

multiplechoiceresponse.p: Escalating a ticket to Tier 2 should be understood as:

choice.div: A failure of the first technician.
A normal step that puts the work where it can be solved.
The end of your responsibility entirely.

div.p: Escalation is a professional routing decision. With clear notes it moves the ticket to the tier that has the access and depth to resolve it.

multiplechoiceresponse.p: The principle of least privilege means you should:

choice.div: Give every user administrator rights so they can self-serve.
Grant only the access an account needs for its job.
Share one privileged account across the support team.

div.p: Least privilege limits both the chance and the impact of a mistake or a compromised account. Grant rights through groups and revoke them when the need ends.
